## :warning: Deprecations

- Deprecate the AWS SDK for Java v1 appenders `CloudWatchLogbackAppender` and `KinesisStreamLogbackAppender`, and their bases `AwsAppender` and `KinesisStreamAppenderBase`. AWS SDK for Java v1 [reached end-of-support on December 31, 2025](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/developer/announcing-end-of-support-for-aws-sdk-for-java-v1-x-on-december-31-2025/), so since January 2026 it gets no more updates, including security fixes. Use `CloudWatchLogbackAppenderV2` and `KinesisStreamLogbackAppenderV2` instead. The SDK v1 appenders now log a warning at start-up and will be removed in 2.0.0

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- CloudWatch appenders never create a missing log stream when `logStreamName` is fixed and `createLogDestination` is `true`; every event is dropped [#9](https://github.com/montss/logback-more-appenders/pull/9)
- CloudWatch appenders stop sending for good after a failed log stream check [#9](https://github.com/montss/logback-more-appenders/pull/9)
- Kinesis appenders send an empty `PutRecords` and duplicate records when only part of a batch fails [#10](https://github.com/montss/logback-more-appenders/pull/10)
- `KinesisStreamLogbackAppender` (AWS SDK v1) sends nothing when credentials come from `profile` or the default credentials chain [#11](https://github.com/montss/logback-more-appenders/pull/11)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Add the AWS SDK for Java v1 end-of-support notice to the README, and mark the SDK v1 dependencies and sample config deprecated
- Link the AWS SDK v2 sample config (`logback-appenders-aws-v2.xml`) from the README
- Add Javadoc to every public class
- Reformat the code to [Google Java Style](https://google.github.io/styleguide/javaguide.html); the build now enforces it

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade AWS SDK for Java from 1.11.1034 to 1.12.797
- Add Maven Checkstyle Plugin 3.6.0 with Checkstyle 9.3, the last Checkstyle that runs on Java 8
- Change License Maven Plugin from 5.1.2 to 4.6, the last version that runs on Java 8
